They are split across the live (unburned) NFTs.         Escrow: 71,174 GENV per NFT, minted here by the token at deploy, vesting linearly over 7 days from         the moment trading starts.         If every NFT has been retired (liveSupply == 0), the holder share of later trades is kept as         `residualFees` and can be sent by anyone, only to the fixed `residualRecipient` (the creator fee         wallet, set at deploy). Trades never revert because of it, and Programmable's 0.3% is not touched:         that is paid by the hook into Programmable's fee vault and never passes through this contract.         Retirement (before an NFT is burned for a child launch) is decided only by the NFT's current holder:         they call `retire` themselves and name the recipient of its ETH fees and vested GENV.
